title: XGBoost-selected nomogram predicts central node metastasis in thyroid microcarcinoma
summary: In 503 patients, XGBoost with SHAP selected five predictors (tumor-capsule distance, microcalcifications, age, BMI, tumor diameter) for a logistic nomogram with AUC 0.862, 0.836 and 0.875 on training, validation and test sets and 0.870 externally (n = 101). D2-40 staining showed higher pericapsular lymphatic density supporting tumor-capsule distance. ML is used only for feature selection and the final model is logistic regression.
ai_technology: XGBoost with SHAP feature selection feeding a logistic regression nomogram
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Wannan Medical College

evidence.tested: External cohort of 101 and D2-40 immunohistochemistry.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
